In *Dark Souls Remastered*, the "best" endgame build depends on your playstyle, but some builds are particularly strong for PvE (bosses, NG+ cycles) and PvP (invasions, duels). Below are the **top-tier endgame builds** that excel in both categories:

---

### **1. Quality Build (Str/Dex Hybrid) – Best All-Rounder**
**Why?** Balanced, versatile, and great for both PvE and PvP. Works with most weapons and has strong defensive options.

#### **Stats (SL120-125, Endgame Meta):**
- **Vigor:** 40-50 (50 for PvP)
- **Endurance:** 20-30 (25-30 for stamina management)
- **Strength:** 40
- **Dexterity:** 40
- **Vitality:** 20-30 (for armor)
- **Intelligence/Faith:** Base (unless using buffs)
- **Attunement:** 10-14 (for 1-2 spell slots)

#### **Weapons (Best Choices):**
- **Claymore** (early-mid game, great moveset)
- **Black Knight Sword** (high damage, low stat reqs)
- **Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed)** (best greatsword, scales with Str/Dex)
- **Chaos/Dark Zweihander** (massive damage, requires Pyromancy)
- **Murakumo** (fast, high poise damage)
- **Washing Pole** (longest range, great for PvP)

#### **Armor:**
- **Havel’s Set** (high poise, heavy)
- **Black Iron Set** (balanced defense)
- **Elite Knight Set** (lightweight, good fashion)
- **Giant’s Set** (high poise, great for tanking)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection** (essential)
- **Havel’s Ring** (if using heavy armor)
- **Chloranthy Ring** (stamina regen)
- **Leo Ring** (counter damage) or **Hornet Ring** (backstabs)

#### **Spells (Optional):**
- **Power Within** (Pyromancy, +20% damage, but drains HP)
- **Darkmoon Blade** (Faith buff, requires 30 Faith)
- **Sunlight Blade** (Faith buff, requires 20 Faith)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** Use **Greatsword of Artorias** or **Chaos Zweihander** for high damage.
- **PvP:** **Murakumo** or **Washing Pole** for range and speed.
- **Buffs:** Apply **Darkmoon Blade** or **Power Within** before fights.

---

### **2. Pure Strength Build – Tanky & High Damage**
**Why?** Simple, hard-hitting, and great for PvE. Struggles in PvP against fast weapons but dominates in duels with the right setup.

#### **Stats (SL120-125):**
- **Vigor:** 50
- **Endurance:** 20-30
- **Strength:** 50
- **Dexterity:** 16 (minimum for weapons)
- **Vitality:** 30-40 (for heavy armor)
- **Attunement:** 10 (for 1 spell slot)

#### **Weapons:**
- **Greatsword** (best Str weapon, high poise damage)
- **Demon’s Greataxe** (highest AR in the game)
- **Smough’s Hammer** (insane poise damage)
- **Dragon Tooth** (fast for a Str weapon)
- **Grant** (divine, great for PvE)

#### **Armor:**
- **Havel’s Set** (best poise)
- **Giant’s Set** (high poise, good fashion)
- **Stone Set** (highest physical defense)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection**
- **Havel’s Ring**
- **Leo Ring** (counter damage)
- **Hornet Ring** (backstabs)

#### **Spells (Optional):**
- **Power Within** (Pyromancy)
- **Sunlight Blade** (if using Grant)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** **Demon’s Greataxe** or **Smough’s Hammer** for one-shotting bosses.
- **PvP:** **Greatsword** or **Dragon Tooth** for poise trades.

---

### **3. Dex Build – Fast & Deadly (Best for PvP)**
**Why?** High speed, low poise requirements, and great for invasions/duels. Struggles against ultra greatswords but dominates in 1v1s.

#### **Stats (SL120-125):**
- **Vigor:** 40-50
- **Endurance:** 20-30
- **Strength:** 16 (minimum)
- **Dexterity:** 45-50
- **Vitality:** 20-30
- **Attunement:** 10-14

#### **Weapons:**
- **Uchigatana** (best Dex weapon, bleed buildup)
- **Iaito** (faster than Uchi, no bleed)
- **Painting Guardian Sword** (long range, great R2s)
- **Chaos/Dark Scimitar** (high damage, bleed)
- **Washing Pole** (longest range, great for PvP)
- **Estoc** (fast, great for parrying)

#### **Armor:**
- **Dark Set** (lightweight, good fashion)
- **Black Leather Set** (fast rolls)
- **Elite Knight Set** (balanced)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection**
- **Chloranthy Ring**
- **Leo Ring** (counter damage)
- **Hornet Ring** (backstabs)

#### **Spells (Optional):**
- **Power Within** (Pyromancy)
- **Darkmoon Blade** (if using buffs)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** **Uchigatana** or **Chaos Scimitar** for bleed.
- **PvP:** **Washing Pole** or **Painting Guardian Sword** for range.

---

### **4. Pyromancer (Chaos/Dark Build) – Highest DPS in PvE**
**Why?** **Chaos/Dark weapons** deal **massive damage** with **low stat requirements**, making them the best for PvE. Also great for PvP with **Power Within**.

#### **Stats (SL120-125):**
- **Vigor:** 40-50
- **Endurance:** 20-30
- **Strength:** 16-20
- **Dexterity:** 16-20
- **Intelligence:** 30-40
- **Faith:** 30-40
- **Vitality:** 20-30
- **Attunement:** 14-18 (for 2-3 spell slots)

#### **Weapons:**
- **Chaos Zweihander** (best PvE weapon in the game)
- **Chaos Greatsword** (high damage, great moveset)
- **Chaos Uchigatana** (fast, bleed)
- **Chaos Claymore** (versatile)
- **Dark Silver Knight Sword** (high damage, low reqs)

#### **Armor:**
- **Dark Set** (lightweight, good fashion)
- **Black Iron Set** (balanced)
- **Elite Knight Set** (lightweight)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection**
- **Chloranthy Ring**
- **Leo Ring** (counter damage)
- **Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring** (boosts Pyromancy damage)

#### **Spells:**
- **Power Within** (essential, +20% damage)
- **Great Combustion** (burst damage)
- **Fire Whip** (great for PvP)
- **Black Flame** (high damage, ignores defense)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** **Chaos Zweihander** + **Power Within** = **one-shot bosses**.
- **PvP:** **Chaos Uchigatana** or **Dark Silver Knight Sword** with **Power Within**.

---

### **5. Faith Build (Sunlight Blade / Darkmoon Blade) – Best Buff Build**
**Why?** **Sunlight Blade** and **Darkmoon Blade** are the **best buffs** in the game, turning any weapon into a **high-damage, magic-infused** monster.

#### **Stats (SL120-125):**
- **Vigor:** 40-50
- **Endurance:** 20-30
- **Strength:** 20-40 (depends on weapon)
- **Dexterity:** 16-40 (depends on weapon)
- **Faith:** 50 (for max buff damage)
- **Attunement:** 14-18 (for 2-3 spell slots)

#### **Weapons:**
- **Greatsword of Artorias (Cursed)** (best buffed weapon)
- **Chaos Claymore** (great moveset)
- **Sunlight Straight Sword** (high Faith scaling)
- **Grant** (divine, great for PvE)

#### **Armor:**
- **Sunset Set** (best fashion for Faith)
- **Elite Knight Set** (lightweight)
- **Dark Set** (if using Darkmoon Blade)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection**
- **Leo Ring** (counter damage)
- **Hornet Ring** (backstabs)
- **Darkmoon Ring** (boosts Darkmoon Blade)

#### **Spells:**
- **Sunlight Blade** (best for Str weapons)
- **Darkmoon Blade** (best for Dex weapons)
- **Wrath of the Gods** (burst damage)
- **Great Magic Barrier** (for PvP)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** **Greatsword of Artorias** + **Sunlight Blade** = **insane damage**.
- **PvP:** **Chaos Claymore** + **Darkmoon Blade** for fast, high-damage attacks.

---

### **6. Sorcerer (Magic Build) – Highest Burst Damage**
**Why?** **Crystal Soul Spear** and **Soul Spear** deal **massive damage**, making this the best **ranged** build for PvE and PvP.

#### **Stats (SL120-125):**
- **Vigor:** 40-50
- **Endurance:** 20-30
- **Strength:** 16
- **Dexterity:** 16
- **Intelligence:** 50 (for max spell damage)
- **Attunement:** 24-30 (for 4-5 spell slots)

#### **Weapons:**
- **Moonlight Greatsword** (best magic weapon)
- **Crystal Greatsword** (high damage, but fragile)
- **Enchanted Falchion** (fast, great for PvP)

#### **Armor:**
- **Tattered Cloth Set** (best magic defense)
- **Elite Knight Set** (lightweight)
- **Black Sorcerer Set** (fashion)

#### **Rings:**
- **Ring of Favor + Protection**
- **Bellowing Dragoncrest Ring** (boosts spell damage)
- **Magic Clutch Ring** (boosts magic damage)
- **Dusk Crown Ring** (boosts spell damage, but halves HP)

#### **Spells:**
- **Crystal Soul Spear** (best PvE spell)
- **Soul Spear** (fast, great for PvP)
- **Homing Soulmass** (auto-tracking)
- **Great Soul Arrow** (fast, low cost)

#### **Playstyle:**
- **PvE:** **Crystal Soul Spear** + **Dusk Crown Ring** = **one-shot bosses**.
- **PvP:** **Moonlight Greatsword** or **Enchanted Falchion** for close combat.

---

### **Best Build Summary (TL;DR):**
| **Build**          | **Best For**       | **Best Weapon**               | **Best Buff**          |
|---------------------|--------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------|
| **Quality (Str/Dex)** | All-Rounder        | Greatsword of Artorias        | Darkmoon Blade         |
| **Pure Strength**    | PvE, Tanking       | Demon’s Greataxe              | Power Within           |
| **Dexterity**        | PvP, Speed         | Washing Pole / Uchigatana     | Darkmoon Blade         |
| **Pyromancer**       | PvE, High DPS      | Chaos Zweihander              | Power Within           |
| **Faith**           | Buffs, PvE         | Greatsword of Artorias        | Sunlight Blade         |
| **Sorcerer**        | Ranged, Burst      | Moonlight Greatsword          | Crystal Soul Spear     |

---

### **Final Recommendations:**
- **Best PvE Build:** **Pyromancer (Chaos Zweihander + Power Within)** – **highest DPS**.
- **Best PvP Build:** **Dex (Washing Pole + Darkmoon Blade)** – **fast, deadly, great range**.
- **Best All-Rounder:** **Quality (Greatsword of Artorias + Darkmoon Blade)** – **versatile, strong in both PvE and PvP**.
- **Easiest Build:** **Pure Strength (Demon’s Greataxe)** – **simple, hard-hitting**.
